name: 브란트-설령 (Brandt-Seolryeong)
hair: 진홍색과 검은색이 섞인 길고 거친 머리카락
outfit: 금색 장식이 박힌 진홍색 가죽 갑옷과 두꺼운 북유럽풍 모피 망토
silhouette: 거대한 모피 망토와 길게 뻗은 곡도의 비대칭적 실루엣, 육중한 체구

visual_en: A massive silhouette featuring a heavy crimson fur cloak adorned with lavish golden ornaments. The character has pale frost-colored skin and long, coarse hair in deep crimson and black. A large, glowing silver scimitar is held in one hand, reflecting a bright lunar light. The eyes are piercing silver-blue. At the waist, a small silver dagger with a tiny ruby glints. The heavy boots are reinforced with metallic studs, and a golden lunar pendant hangs prominently over the dark leather armor. Faint frost particles drift from the heavy hem of the cloak.
pose_en: Standing tall and imposing, poised to strike with a heavy, menacing stance.
vfx_en: A crescent-shaped wave of deep crimson and silver light expanding outwards.
